name: Audio
description: Paste text as a spoken audio file, or a copied recording or video as its transcript
author: georgemandis

voice.label: Voice
voice.description: Automatic picks the best installed voice for the language of the text. Add higher-quality voices in System Settings, under Accessibility, Spoken Content.

language.label: Transcript language
language.description: The language spoken in the recording. Transcription runs on this Mac; a language must be set up for Dictation in System Settings, under Keyboard.
